get.description: 仅供 QCS 等内部 sidecar 使用。Phase 2、精确 allowlist 和该 scope 的 bpi.qcs-link 均启用后才可访问；零条返回 404，多条返回 409，不做猜测。

post.description: 仅供受信 WMS sidecar 使用。Protobuf 内嵌 commandEventId 和 idempotencyKey；BPI 只在对应红单 outbox 已发布后接受回执。

NotFound.description: 对象不存在或无权访问

Forbidden.description: 角色、作用域或功能门禁不允许该操作

Conflict.description: revision 冲突或对象已处理

ForceCloseTaskAccepted.description: 强制结束申请或审批任务已受理

ForceCloseTaskResult.description: 最近一次强制结束任务；从未申请时 data 为 null

WmsInboundReversalTaskAccepted.description: 完工入库冲销申请或审批任务已受理

enabled.description: Required when mode is SET and ignored when mode is INHERIT

propertyId.description: Canonical property identity emitted by the exporter and consumed by BPI.

sourcePropertyId.description: Original JetLinks/source property identity before exporter normalization.

calibrationStatus.description: Source assertion captured at import time only. It never grants operational readiness without independent MES calibration approval.

sourceSequenceEnabled.description: Source claim only. Operational readiness additionally requires a matching fresh qualification event.

sourceSequenceRequired.description: True when the binding rejects exporter fallback sequences and requires a stable DEVICE or GATEWAY source sequence.

sourceCalibrationStatus.description: Untrusted source assertion retained for audit.

calibrationStatus.description: Authoritative MES status derived from an approved, currently effective evidence record.

sourceSequenceQualified.description: True only when a fresh qualification event matches the current source instance, origin, device and binding fingerprint.

source.description: Flink processing stage that emitted the issue

artifactUri.description: READY 时为带 versionId 查询参数的精确 s3:// 对象版本

DatasetMlflowRegistration.description: 不可变恢复包的 MLflow Dataset Input 登记。REGISTERED 只证明数据输入与血缘复验通过，不代表模型训练、模型注册、在线推理或生产激活。

mlflowDatasetSource.description: REGISTERED 时为带 versionId 查询参数的精确 s3:// 恢复对象版本

registrationMetadata.description: 成功时必须证明 datasetInputVerified 和 lineageVerified 为 true，同时模型训练、注册、在线推理与生产激活边界均为 false
